item: Civil Health Insurance: emergency visit to a contracted private hospital covered up to this amount without prior approval
item_ar: مراجعة طوارىء المستشفيات الخاصة المتعاقد معها لغاية مبلغ (75) دينار مباشرة
notes: Above 75 JD needs approval from the contracted company. Insurance fund covers 80% of private-hospital treatment cost; the patient pays 20%. Medicines: patient pays 5% per item, min 250 fils, max 10 JD per discharge prescription. Applies to first-class and second/third-class government-employee categories (MoH HIA brochure, undated; downloaded 2026-10-24).

notes: Expressed as 38 points, 'in line with 2008 fees'; no JD amount is printed, so none is given here. Gazette page 5401. JMA 'لائحة تعرفة الأجور الطبية لعام 2024' as printed in the Official Gazette (pages 5398-5402), read from page images republished by Akhbar al-Urdun (jornews.com) 2024-11-16. Art. 1: in force 30 days after Gazette publication; JMA medical societies said it entered force 2024-11-16 (Al-Mamlaka, 2024-11-16). CONTESTED: the Health Minister cancelled an earlier 2024 schedule (Gazette 5932, 2024-06-13) in July 2024 and kept the 2008 schedule; the Jordan Health Insurance Society and Jordan Insurance Federation announced their own increases from 2024-11-16 (GP consultation +100%, specialist +50%, 2008 procedures +20% excluding radiology). Which tariff an insurer actually pays is not settled by this document.
